questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The equation of continuity for the streamline flow of an incompressible liquid, av = constant, expresses the conservation of:
questions.explanation: The same mass of liquid must pass every cross-section each second, so the speed rises where the tube narrows. Bernoulli's theorem is the energy statement.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 9: Mechanical Properties of Fluids

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a forced oscillation, the amplitude of the oscillator becomes very large when the driving frequency:
options: Is much lower than the natural frequency
Is equal to the natural frequency of the oscillator
Is much higher than the natural frequency
questions.explanation: This is resonance, and damping alone limits the amplitude. Soldiers break step on a bridge for exactly this reason.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: When a radioactive nucleus emits a beta minus particle, its atomic number and mass number respectively:
options: Increase by 1 and stay the same
Decrease by 1 and stay the same
Stay the same and decrease by 1
questions.explanation: A neutron turns into a proton with the emission of an electron and an antineutrino, so Z rises by one while A is unchanged. Alpha emission is the one that lowers Z by 2 and A by 4.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The Pauli exclusion principle states that in an atom:
options: No two electrons can have the same set of all four quantum numbers
All electrons must have parallel spins
Electrons fill the highest energy orbital first
An orbital can hold four electrons
questions.explanation: Two electrons in one orbital share n, l and m but must differ in spin, which is why an orbital holds at most two electrons and a subshell 2(2l+1).
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The rusting of iron is best described as:
options: An electrochemical process in which iron acts as the anode and is oxidised
A reaction needing neither air nor moisture
questions.explanation: Tiny galvanic cells form on the surface: iron is oxidised to Fe²⁺ at anodic spots while oxygen is reduced at cathodic spots, so both air and water are essential.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Benzene diazonium chloride, on treatment with phenol in a mildly alkaline medium, gives an orange dye. This reaction is called:
questions.explanation: The diazonium ion is a weak electrophile and attacks the activated para position of phenol, giving an azo compound. Such azo dyes are widely used in the textile industry.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which plant growth regulator is a gas and hastens the ripening of fruits?
questions.explanation: Ethylene also promotes senescence, leaf abscission and the breaking of seed dormancy in peanut, and ethephon is used commercially as its source.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 13: Plant Growth and Development

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which of the following is an outbreeding device that prevents self pollination in flowering plants?
options: Self incompatibility, where the pollen cannot germinate on the same plant's stigma
Bisexual flowers that open before maturity
questions.explanation: Other devices include the anther and stigma maturing at different times and being placed at different positions. Cleistogamous flowers, in contrast, are always self pollinated.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Flame cells, which are specialised excretory cells, are characteristic of phylum:
questions.explanation: Flatworms such as Planaria and the liver fluke use flame cells for osmoregulation and excretion, and they are dorsoventrally flattened and acoelomate.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The symptoms of an allergic reaction such as sneezing and watery eyes are caused mainly by the release of:
options: Histamine and serotonin from mast cells
questions.explanation: An allergen triggers IgE mediated release of these chemicals, which is why antihistamines relieve the symptoms.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease
